description.zh: 要开启DNSSEC服务的DNS域名，仅支持付费版DNS用户。
description.en: The domain name for which you want to enable DNSSEC. This feature is available only to users of paid Alibaba Cloud DNS.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en

description.zh:
Dnssec状态：

- ON 开启
- OFF 关闭
description.en:
The status of DNSSEC. Valid values:

- ON: Enables DNSSEC.

- OFF: Disables DNSSEC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns set-domain-dnssec-status --lang en --domain-name example.com --status ON --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SetDomainDnssecStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status ON --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en
